# Psychology and Personal Development

## Current State

Hanji 798 adds a narrow psychology-adjacent moral-presence case: Huang Xian refuses formal office yet becomes a comparative standard for Yuan Lang, Dai Liang, Chen Fan, Xun Shu, and Guo Tai, so the personal-development branch gains a non-clinical example of self-command, reputation, and ambition-checking outside institutional title. VOL.214 adds a workplace-abuse branch: repeated humiliation, exclusion, threat, task overload, and parent or supervisor pressure are interpreted through [[WorkplaceBullying]], [[StructuralPowerImbalance]], [[PsychologicalAbuseRecognition]], [[WorkSelfWorthBoundary]], and [[PsychologicalBoundaryProtection]] rather than through victim self-blame; complaint channels and psychological techniques remain source-scoped. VOL.216 adds a medicalized self-control boundary: online prefrontal-cortex, dopamine, and ADHD language can name real mechanisms, but everyday impulse, distraction, emotional lapses, and late-night consumption are interpreted through bodily state, environment, learned cues, and clinical thresholds rather than one brain-region blame object. The Harris Huberman Lab episode adds direct meditation self-observation: [[NonDualMindfulness]] treats the apparent observer as an appearance in awareness, [[AwarenessMeditationStoryDropping]] makes self-talk and anger stories observable, and [[PsychedelicOrdinaryFreedom]] keeps peak experiences subordinate to ordinary waking freedom. The Willink Huberman Lab Essentials episode adds a discipline-centered self-command branch: action is decoupled from current motivation through [[DisciplineOverMotivation]], bodily discomfort is treated as bounded practice through [[AutonomicStressTraining]], [[OperationalDetachment]] widens attention before decision, and [[LeadershipEmotionalCounterweight]] and [[ActionAfterAdversity]] turn leadership and resilience into action-after-emotion practices; exercise, nutrition timing, battlefield, parenting, leadership, and resilience claims remain source-scoped. The Adolphs Huberman Lab episode adds a functional emotion-regulation branch: emotions are control states useful for decision and motivation, while granularity, early reappraisal, body-state evidence, and transition management shift regulation away from suppression; its AI-emotion, cold-exposure, endurance, solitude, meditation, amygdala, facial-expression, and body-map claims remain source-scoped. Episode 700 adds a collective trust-rupture case: Bloody Sunday shows institutional violence resetting a community relationship to an armed force, while Bloody Friday shows violent strategy reversing support. Hanji 1040 adds latent rival recognition and crisis composure: Cao Cao reads Liu Bei's ambition, reputation, resilience, and composure as future-threat signals, while Liu Bei survives the "天下英雄" moment through a plausible cover story; the same source turns release of a protected guest into dangerous guest release risk when operational freedom lets Liu Bei recover Xuzhou. Hanji 901 adds impatience control to the personal-development branch: the episode frames 急性子 as anxiety, compulsion, rigid thinking, result fixation, and self-importance, then offers a small reaction interval through the count-to-three pause and Kafka example. Hanji 892 adds a speech-restraint precursor: 修止语 extends the branch from daily complaint control into exposure management through Adversity Silence Discipline. Hanji 902 adds strategic emotion concealment to the personal-development branch: the episode treats uncontrolled display as a survival risk and uses Liu Meng, Zhang Huan, Duan Jiong, and Su Buwei to distinguish timing and self-command from moral endorsement of every tactic. Hanji 1029 adds character-reading delegation to the psychology branch: Sun Ce trusts Taishi Ci's promise, and that trust becomes useful only when Taishi Ci returns with concrete Yuzhang intelligence; the same source's windfall opening treats sudden wealth as a test of restraint, boundaries, and self-knowledge. Data Science With Sam EP47 keeps AI assistance under human judgment and verification, and EP278 extends that boundary into student formation by treating non-algorithmic capabilities, human agency, connection, and pacing as safeguards against becoming tool-like. April 13 Marketplace Tech shows that perceived authorship can affect trust in emotionally meaningful work. Hanji 1024 adds a direct desire-and-self-command case: Lü Bu has force, advisers, allies, and a city-defense plan, but cannot hold one strategic judgment long enough to turn those assets into durable initiative. Hanji 930 reframes greed and resentment as prompts to build exchangeable capability, and Hanji 962, Hanji 970, and Hanji 999 show relationship trust becoming condition-dependent under violence, assassination risk, grain, protection, and family-safety pressure. Hanji 997 adds emotional attachment as a judgment-risk case, Hanji 1012 shows private desire breaking fragile surrender trust, and Hanji 1015 frames ambition as dangerous when title, timing, recognition, and capacity do not match. The market and workplace paragraphs add the same calibration problem in newer settings: Unitree enthusiasm needs commercial self-checks, investing needs stop-loss and position-sizing discipline, workplace relationships need explicit boundaries, agent automation needs permission limits and human verification, middle-class consumption needs identity-cost discipline, and organizational trust can become both asset and liability. Episode 692 adds a collective-judgment case: confessional trauma memory, Campion's charisma, and the pastoral-versus-subversion ambiguity show how sincere mission can become threatening when identity, legitimacy, and security fear are already coupled. The Andy Stalman episode adds a human-centered AI and meaning branch: angelic intelligence, human value beyond efficiency, and AI-as-mirror framing treat technology as an amplifier that needs purpose, beauty, connection, and judgment rather than pure productivity. Hanji 1042 adds a judgment-and-exposure case: Tian Feng's coherent attritional advice is punished when blunt correction meets Yuan Shao's arrogance, adviser factionalism, and pre-battle morale anxiety, so the personal-development reading turns from being right to timing, hierarchy, and recipient-state calibration. Vol.272 adds a practical trust-perception case: spare-bedroom sharing depends on whether cash-flow pressure, host identity, female guest safety, and escrow-like fulfillment can make a stranger-in-home transaction feel acceptable. Hanji 1043 adds opponent-state reading before Guandu: Ju Shou risk and commander-fit warnings, Cheng Yu small-garrison judgment, and Cao Cao White Horse diversion show personal judgment as timing, recipient and enemy-state calibration, and restraint under pressure. The Rubin Huberman Lab episode adds a creativity-specific self-command case: useful self-doubt, attention shifts, deliberate disengagement, feedback boundaries, and meditation/story-dropping can support work only when they balance rather than replace felt judgment. Hanji 1055 adds a narrow psychology-adjacent restraint case: Cheng Ji and Yan Pu model self-command under fear, obligation, and status temptation, while the episode opening merit and career framing remains source-scoped rather than a general psychology doctrine. Hanji 1053 adds a leadership-judgment case to the psychology-adjacent branch: Sun Quan's early strength comes from observed personnel judgment, advice intake, and threat discipline, while Liu Zhang shows that mildness without authority cannot integrate powerful subordinates and resented troops. The Cesar Millan Huberman Lab episode extends self-command into companion-animal interaction: calm nonverbal posture, observation before correction, and consistent rituals make the human's state part of the dog's behavioral environment while keeping energy and pack-language claims source-scoped. Hanji 1058 adds a source-scoped intimacy-psychology opening about unmet maternal love, anxious dependence, projection, and self-repair; it remains personal-reflection framing rather than clinical guidance or historical causation.
